name: society-management
description: Documentation toolchain for the Society Management codebase (28 module identities).

scripts.docs:api: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),cp=require('child_process'),path=require('path');const NL=String.fromCharCode(10),CR=String.fromCharCode(13),BT=String.fromCharCode(96),EM=String.fromCharCode(8212),EL=String.fromCharCode(8230);const walk=d=>fs.existsSync(d)?fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true}).flatMap(e=>e.isDirectory()?walk(path.join(d,e.name)):[path.join(d,e.name)]):[];const mods=['src','tests'].flatMap(walk).filter(f=>path.basename(f).startsWith('file_')&&f.endsWith('.js'));const data=JSON.parse(cp.execSync('jsdoc2md --configure jsdoc.json --files src/utils/filler.js --json',{encoding:'utf8',maxBuffer:512*1024*1024}));const byFile={},seen=new Set();data.forEach(d=>{if(d.kind==='function'&&d.meta&&d.meta.filename){const k=d.meta.filename+':'+d.meta.lineno;if(seen.has(k))return;seen.add(k);(byFile[d.meta.filename]=byFile[d.meta.filename]||[]).push(d);}});mods.forEach(f=>{const norm=f.split(path.sep).join('/');const base=path.basename(f);const id=path.basename(f,'.js').replace('file_','mod_');const rel=norm.startsWith('src/')?'docs/api-reference/'+norm.slice(4):'docs/api-reference/tests/'+norm.slice(6);const page=rel.slice(0,rel.lastIndexOf('/')+1)+id+'.md';if(!fs.existsSync(page))throw new Error('docs:api: expected page not found: '+page);const fns=(byFile[base]||[]).slice().sort((p,q)=>p.meta.lineno-q.meta.lineno);if(!fns.length)throw new Error('docs:api: no functions found for '+page);const first=fns[0].name,last=fns[fns.length-1].name;const rows=fns.map(d=>{const pnames=(d.params||[]).map(p=>p.name).join(', ');const pcell=(d.params||[]).map(p=>BT+p.name+BT+' ('+BT+((p.type&&p.type.names)||[]).join('|')+BT+')').join(', ');const rcell=(d.returns||[]).map(r=>BT+((r.type&&r.type.names)||[]).join('|')+BT).join(', ');const desc=(d.description||'').trim();return '| '+BT+d.name+'('+pnames+')'+BT+' | '+pcell+' | '+rcell+' | '+desc+' |';});const cur=fs.readFileSync(page,'utf8');const E=cur.indexOf(CR+NL)>=0?CR+NL:NL;const md='**Functions:** '+fns.length+' '+EM+' '+BT+first+BT+' '+EL+' '+BT+last+BT+E+E+'| Function | Parameter | Returns | Description |'+E+'| --- | --- | --- | --- |'+E+rows.join(E);const a='<!-- docs:api:START -->',b='<!-- docs:api:END -->';const i=cur.indexOf(a),j=cur.indexOf(b);if(i<0||j<0||j<i)throw new Error('docs:api: missing START/END markers in '+page);fs.writeFileSync(page,cur.slice(0,i+a.length)+E+md+E+cur.slice(j));});"
scripts.docs:build: npm run docs:api && npm run docs:diagrams && npm run docs:pdf
